subject: expression: constant skip the push-down check when to propagate constant (#63376)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent (bd5c1945819e0829dbefd1d8e4e981c9a565e650) limited to expression constant propagation. Change gates `vaildExprFunc` so it is not invoked for constant-folded results (`*expression.Constant`) produced during column-equality propagation, avoiding incorrect rejection / join-side classification edge cases while leaving non-constant validation unchanged. Regression test added under `pkg/expression/test/constantpropagation/constant_propagation_test.go` to assert propagated predicates appear in pushed-down cop selections. Checked later history up to `upstream/master` and the same “skip validity check for constants” approach remains (with subsequent refactors), so no remaining Blocker/High issues identified.
